articles.summary: Second Quarter 2025 Highlights Earnings per diluted share (EPS) from continuing operations of $1.37, up 20%, and adjusted EPS from continuing operations of $1.49, up 24%. Sales of $577.2 million, up 9.2% driven by 6.5% core sales growth. Core order growth up 19.6% and core backlog growth up 18.2%, driven primarily by ongoing strength at Aerospace Electronics. Announced agreement to acquire Precision Sensors Instrumentation (“PSI”) on June 9, 2025. Declaring third quarter 2025 regular
articles.title: Crane Company Reports Second Quarter 2025 Results and Raises Full Year Adjusted EPS Guidance
